name: My Cousin's Bride
source:
Have you ever wanted to see your girlfriend with someone else?

Our heroine Luh just wants to spend some romantic time with her boyfriend, not knowing that he intends to make her deepest wish come true and, at the same time, help his cousin Danny.

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240321071007/https://belmonthstudio.gumroad.com/l/nbvscv]Gumroad[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾想过，看着自己的女友与别人在一起？

女主人公露只想和男友共度一段浪漫时光，却不知道，他正打算实现她内心最深处的愿望，同时帮一帮自己的表亲丹尼。

[译编自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240321071007/https://belmonthstudio.gumroad.com/l/nbvscv]Gumroad[/url]]
